scientific.integrity: The source Algorithm 2 recurrence is solved exactly for a persistent alternating input. Bias correction makes the squared-gradient state exact at every iteration, after which the clipped inertia map and first-moment recurrence admit closed forms.
limitations: Persistent alternating-gradient input-response theorem rather than fixed-objective convergence.
Amplitude reversal occurs only in the unclipped adaptive-inertia branch.
No claim about stochastic generalization or arbitrary frequency spectra.

title: Adaptive Inertia reverses coordinate amplitudes under alternating gradients
